|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern Alternate Image (ALT) card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Bow To The First Order (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-bowtothefirstorder_ai-2023-01-21.png]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the first image of this Alternate Image card already prints “E1”: the mark follows the errata count of the card's text (the regular card had been errata'd before this image was made), but this image is the first version of the Alternate Image card. Recorded as printed and listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
